messages:
maria-cs: Quick heads up — onboarding delays observed for tenants provisioned during the EU index migration last night. ~15 tenants affected (12 trials, 3 high-touch). Need customer comms, localized copies, and a credit proposal.

ashley-se: Please DM the tenant list and a short RCA we can paste in the note. ETA to full recovery?

maria-cs: DMing list now. RCA: indexer backlog + aggressive provisioning retries hit a rate limiter during the migration window.

sam-eng: Mitigations applied: spun up extra indexer workers, relaxed provisioning retry backoff, and temporarily widened limiter window for onboarding traffic. Queue depth is dropping; expect most tenants to catch up in 30-45 minutes.

neil-ops: Limiter config change deployed at 17:18 UTC, backfill started. 9/15 tenants fully backfilled; remaining 6 actively catching up. Monitoring closely.

lina-localization: I can translate to FR/DE/ES once you give me the final subject + body. Will include region-specific office-hours CTAs.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency" Severity=S2 Owners=sam-eng,neil-ops,maria-cs

maria-cs: Draft outbound (short & customer-facing):

Subject: Update: onboarding delay during EU migration — remediation and offer

Hi <Customer name>,

We wanted to let you know that customers onboarded during a recent platform migration in the EU region experienced a provisioning delay. Our engineering team has implemented a fix and your tenant's index should be available shortly.

What we did: increased processing capacity, adjusted provisioning retries, and monitored the backlog until caught up.
What we’re offering: 1 week of platform credits (2 weeks for customers on our high-touch plan) and a 1:1 office-hours slot if you’d like guided help. If you have an urgent import need, reply and we'll prioritize it.

We’re sorry for the disruption — we will follow up with a short post-incident summary and a feedback survey so we can improve the onboarding flow.

Best,
Redwood Inference Customer Success & Ops

ashley-se: Edit suggestion: change "recent platform migration" to "scheduled EU migration" and add the prioritization line you included. Also ensure the subject lines are localized.

maria-cs: Noted. Lina, please return translations in 20m. I’ll send individualized notes to the 3 high-touch accounts within 45m including credits and scheduling links; CS-ops will send the bulk localized message to trials once translations are available. We’ll include a 2-question feedback form and a link to book 1:1 if needed.

sam-eng: Adding a snippet for RCA logs for the post-incident summary:

neil-ops: I’ll post a final tally when all tenants are backfilled.
